thread:
maria (eng-release): Heads-up — customer reported 500s from embeddings in prod eu-west-1 when inputs exceed ~64k tokens. Root cause looks like kv-cache overflow on long prefix. PR with fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987. Requesting hotfix canary + expedited approval for a 30m change window. image: ghcr.io/redwood/serve:hotfix-eu-987

sam (sre): Canary from a dry run showed ~4% error last night. What rollback criteria are we using?

maria (eng-release): Rollback if errors > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > +2s over baseline. Also CPU > 85% sustained 2m triggers rollback. Perf diff: https://perf.redwood/compare/987

anya (oncall): oncall approves those criteria. :white_check_mark: Can we start canary at 5% traffic?

maria (eng-release): Yes — start 5% canary, pin to image tag hotfix-eu-987. No DB/schema changes.

leo (infra): infra looks clear for eu-west capacity. Need container digest before I allow rollout.

maria (eng-release): Image digest: ghcr.io/redwood/serve@sha256:abc123def4567890. CI passed post-merge (GH Actions #348). Deploy request follows.

deploybot: @maria requested deploy to eu-west-1: image=ghcr.io/redwood/serve@sha256:abc123def4567890 mode=canary traffic=5% window=30m. Prechecks: infra OK, smoke tests passed (staging). Rollout policy: canary->50%->100% with manual approves.

kate (product): Product ack for release notes. Suggested blurb: "Fix: embeddings 500 for >64k inputs in eu-west-1 (hotfix)" — will notify CS.

zack (security): Quick security check: no new IAM perms, image scanned, OK. :shield:

sam (sre): I'll be monitoring metrics and ready to cut rollback. Paging @maria if thresholds hit.

maria (eng-release): Thanks. Who can +1 for expedited approval so we can bypass the weekly release meeting?

leo (infra): +1 (infra)

anya (oncall): +1 (oncall)

zack (security): +1 (sec)

kate (product): +1 (product)

sam (sre): +1 (sre)

maria (eng-release): Great — starting canary now. /deploybot execute

deploybot: Deploy started — canary pods replacing old pods (scale 3->3). Rolling logs: 

kubectl rollout status deployment/serve-eu-west1-canary

maria (eng-release): Smoke check: initial canary pod healthy, basic embed test returns 200 OK.

sam (sre): Seeing 0.3% errors in first 5m, p95 latency unchanged. continuing to monitor.

[10m]
sam (sre): 12m check — error rate 0.5%, p95 +30ms. still below rollback.

maria (eng-release): Moving to 50% per plan in 8m unless objections.

leo (infra): go for it.

maria (eng-release): Bumping to 50% now. /deploybot traffic 50%

deploybot: Traffic shifted to 50%. New pods scaled successfully.

maria (eng-release): Starting final 30m check.

sam (sre): 30m check — error rate 0.6%, CPU spikes cleared. Metrics green. Approve 100% roll.

maria (eng-release): Rolling to 100% in 2m. /deploybot traffic 100%

deploybot: Roll to 100% completed. All automated checks passed. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release/2026-03-23-hotfix-eu-987

kate (product): I updated release note and pinged CS + affected accounts. :rocket:

maria (eng-release): Closing thread. Audit tags: #hotfix #eu-west-1 hotfix-eu-987 PR#987

deploybot: Audit event recorded: event_id=evt-20260323-987, deploy_id=deploy-1829999999.

maria (eng-release): Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. :heart:
